nodes.name: Control camera
nodes.responsibility: Fit, pan, and zoom locally
nodes.description: Computes clamped camera transforms for the server drawing without persisting or inventing board geometry.

nodes.name: Select semantic subjects
nodes.responsibility: Map gestures through the atlas
nodes.description: Accepts only semantic IDs present in the server atlas and toggles the shared attention mark on rendered groups.

nodes.name: Follow drill-downs
nodes.responsibility: Navigate linked board levels
nodes.description: Resolves a link's exact current or named target variant against the target board's document and says its lifecycle before it is opened; a named variant that is gone is reported, never swapped for the current one. nodes.name: Drive walkthrough focus
nodes.responsibility: Focus each narrative beat

nodes.name: Refresh changed boards
nodes.responsibility: Invalidate live cached drawings

nodes.name: Viewer entry point
nodes.responsibility: Mount queries and reading state
nodes.description: SemanticBoardStage, mounted by ApplicationPane. It asks the query cache for the picture of the reading on screen, owns the reading hooks (drill trail, level, variant, walkthrough, fit, report) and hands the answer to renderedView.

nodes.name: Picture source
nodes.responsibility: Where a pane's pictures come from: the renderer this page installed at start, or the server's render route

nodes.name: Picture cache
nodes.responsibility: Holds a drawing only as a read-only cache, stamped with the version, policy and renderer build it was made for
nodes.description: ADR 0023: the browser owns presentation and nothing else. A stamp that no longer matches is not shown.

nodes.name: Draw here
nodes.responsibility: Draws the board in this tab, with the tab's own canvas and worker pool

nodes.name: Semantic queries
nodes.responsibility: The cache keys and freshness of the listing, a board's document and a picture

nodes.name: Local pictures

nodes.name: Keep fitted

nodes.name: Walkthrough position
nodes.responsibility: Which walkthrough is open and at which step: chosen by hand, or driven by narration or a recording

nodes.name: Report the reading

nodes.name: Camera glide
nodes.responsibility: Glides the camera to its next place over a set time, writing the surface's transform a frame at a time
nodes.description: The camera is committed to state once, at the end, and the surface carries data-camera-motion while it flies. A gesture stops it where it is. It reads the time and its frames from the frame clock, so a replay steps it to each frame's time.

nodes.name: Picture transition
nodes.responsibility: Carries one picture into the next: kept parts fly to their new places, departed ones fade, and the traffic's clock carries over
nodes.description: It writes the picture into the surface itself, once per picture. Flights read the time and their frames from the frame clock, and the traffic's SVG time is read and set through it, so a replay seeks every one of them to the frame's time.

nodes.name: Board reads
nodes.responsibility: Where a board's document and the vault check are read from: the server's routes, or a replay's talk
nodes.description: Swapped once with readBoardsFrom, before anything is read, as the picture source is. On a replay page every read answers the talk's snapshot, so a refetch returns the same board, and a read of any other board is a violation.

nodes.name: Frame clock
nodes.responsibility: The clock that motion reads: the browser's own on a live page, a stepped one on a replay
nodes.description: A replay swaps it once, before it mounts anything (driveFramesFrom). Its stepped clock also takes over the browser's own requestAnimationFrame, so a library's frames run on it too. It stands every animation and SVG clock at the frame's time, and an animation on a timeline it cannot stand is a violation. A lint rule keeps the viewer on it rather than on the browser's timers.

nodes.name: Walkthrough replay
nodes.responsibility: Mounts one viewer on a recorded talk and steps it frame by frame
nodes.description: The page a recording's picture is rendered in (drawn on Browser application and Board rasterizer). Loading a talk points the board reads at it, installs the stepped clock and mounts the viewer on the talk's board, its step driven by the talk.

nodes.responsibility: The cache keys and freshness of the listing, a board's document and a picture
nodes.description: No timer: a picture and a document stay fresh until their board announces a new version, and are read again on a reconnect. The last picture of the same board stays as the placeholder while another reading of it is drawn.

nodes.name: Keep fitted
nodes.responsibility: Fits the whole reading, or the walkthrough step, until somebody pans or zooms
nodes.description: A new board, variant or view fits the entire selected reading; each walkthrough step takes the camera back and fits its subjects; a new picture glides from the last reading, and leaving a presentation glides back.

nodes.name: Walkthrough position
nodes.responsibility: Which walkthrough is open and at which step: chosen by hand, or driven by narration or a recording

nodes.name: Report the reading
nodes.responsibility: Tells the pane what is on screen, only when it changes

nodes.name: Archboard server
nodes.responsibility: Answers the semantic read routes

nodes.name: Camera glide
nodes.responsibility: Glides the camera to its next place over a set time, writing the surface's transform a frame at a time
nodes.description: The camera is committed to state once, at the end, and the surface carries data-camera-motion while it flies. A gesture stops it where it is. It reads the time and its frames from the frame clock, so a replay steps it to each frame's time.

nodes.name: Picture transition
nodes.responsibility: Carries one picture into the next: kept parts fly to their new places, departed ones fade, and the traffic's clock carries over
nodes.description: It writes the picture into the surface itself, once per picture, and runs the traffic of each picture, ghost and borrowed group as it puts them up. Flights read the time and their frames from the frame clock, and the picture clock its traffic runs on is read and set through it, so a replay seeks every one of them to the frame's time.

nodes.name: Board reads
nodes.responsibility: Where a board's document and the vault check are read from: the server's routes, or a replay's talk
nodes.description: Swapped once with readBoardsFrom, before anything is read, as the picture source is. On a replay page every read answers the talk's snapshot, so a refetch returns the same board, and a read of any other board is a violation.

nodes.name: Frame clock
